name: SEO Information Viewer & Analyzer
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
SEO Information Viewer & Analyzer is an advanced WordPress admin SEO toolkit designed to give you complete visibility into on-page SEO without affecting the frontend.

It helps developers, site owners, and SEO teams analyze content, find issues, compare posts, audit sites in bulk, and inspect advanced SEO signals — all from one clean dashboard.

🔍 SEO Analyzer

  • Visual SEO score with progress bar
  • Readability score and grade
  • Word count and heading structure (H1–H3)
  • Image count and missing ALT text
  • Internal and external link counts
  • Canonical URL and index status
  • Detailed SEO overview per post/page

✏️ Meta Title & Description Editor

  • View and edit SEO titles and meta descriptions
  • Character length validation
  • SERP preview
  • Detect missing or short meta tags

🚨 SEO Recommendations

Actionable SEO suggestions with priority levels:
– Missing or short meta titles
– Missing meta descriptions
– Missing or multiple H1 tags
– Low word count
– Missing internal links
– Missing focus keyword

🧩 SEO Issues Filter

Instantly filter posts by common SEO problems:
– Missing or invalid titles
– No meta descriptions
– Missing or multiple H1 tags
– Missing image ALT text
– Low word count
– No internal links
– Noindex status

Ideal for fixing SEO issues at scale.

📊 Compare SEO Between Posts

Compare SEO metrics between two posts or pages:
– Title comparison
– Word count difference
– Image and ALT usage
– Meta description length
– Clear difference indicators

Learn best practices by comparing stronger content.

🔑 Keyword Analysis

  • Focus keyword analysis
  • Keyword count and density
  • Keyword presence in:
    • SEO title
    • H1 heading
  • Optimization score
  • SEO recommendations
  • Extensible keyword suggestions

✅ SEO Optimization Checklist

Post-level SEO checklist with pass/fail status:
– SEO title length (30–60 chars)
– Meta description length (120–160 chars)
– Word count (300+ recommended)
– Exactly one H1 tag
– Image ALT text coverage
– Internal link recommendations

🌐 URL Checker

Analyze any URL on your site:
– HTTP status code
– Page title
– Meta description
– H1 count
– Canonical URL
– Meta robots (index / noindex)

Useful for auditing published pages and debugging SEO issues.

📦 Bulk SEO Audit

Scan multiple posts at once and get a summarized SEO report:
– Select post type and limit
– Average SEO score
– Total issues found:
– Missing titles
– Missing meta descriptions
– Missing or multiple H1 tags
– Missing ALT text
– Low word count
– Noindex pages
– Designed for large websites
– Fast AJAX-powered audits

🔧 Advanced SEO Tools

Collection of advanced, read-only SEO checks:

Meta Robots Checker

  • Detect index / noindex / nofollow directives

Canonical Checker

  • Verify canonical URL
  • Compare canonical vs permalink
  • Detect mismatches

Structured Data (JSON-LD)

  • Detect schema / structured data presence

Hreflang Checker

  • Detect hreflang links for multilingual SEO

Sitemap Checker

  • Check for sitemap availability at common locations

Broken External Links

  • Scan posts for broken outbound links

Redirect Checker

  • Detect redirects and final destination URLs
  • HTTP status verification

Social Preview

  • Preview Open Graph title and description
  • Useful for social sharing optimization

Keyword Gap (Site-wide)

  • Detect most frequently used keywords across content

Accessibility Quick Checks

  • Missing image ALT attributes
  • H1 heading presence
  • Basic accessibility indicators

⚡ Performance & Privacy

  • Fully admin-side only
  • AJAX-powered UI
  • Lightweight and fast
  • No frontend output
  • No external tracking or data sharing

🧩 SEO Plugin Compatibility

Detects and reads SEO data from:
– Yoast SEO
– Rank Math
– All in One SEO (AIOSEO)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open SEO Information Viewer & Analyzer from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Start analyzing and auditing your content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace Yoast or Rank Math?

No. It complements existing SEO plugins by analyzing and displaying their stored SEO data.

Does it modify frontend output?

No. All features are admin-only.

Can I edit meta titles and descriptions?

Yes, directly from the analyzer screen.

Is it suitable for large websites?

Yes. Bulk audit, filters, and exports are optimized for large sites.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes, supported post types can be analyzed.
